testcase.name: Scenario: Show the Front label without a diagonal stroke across the orientation face: mnt/vininas-projects/MCAD-Scenarios/features/application/viewport-orientation/viewport-orientation.feature:35:3
testcase.system-out: Scenario: Show the Front label without a diagonal stroke across the orientation face ✔ Given `fixtures/cad/docking-visible-solid-current.opd` is active with its rectangular block visible in the MCAD Software ✔ And the viewport orientation control displays the Front view ✔ When the user inspects the visible orientation face ✔ Then the square face is labeled FRONT in uppercase ✔ And no diagonal stroke crosses the face ✔ And the block and model browser remain visible

testcase.name: Scenario: Rotate and restore a face-on view: mnt/vininas-projects/MCAD-Scenarios/features/application/viewport-orientation/viewport-orientation.feature:52:3
testcase.system-out: Scenario: Rotate and restore a face-on view ✔ Given `fixtures/cad/docking-visible-solid-current.opd` is active with its rectangular block visible in the MCAD Software ✔ And the orientation control displays Front with its label upright ✔ And the block's front face is wider than it is tall on screen ✔ When the user selects the upper curved rotation arrow on the orientation control ✔ Then the control still displays Front with its label rotated by a quarter turn ✔ And the block's front face is taller than it is wide on screen ✔ When the user selects the other curved rotation arrow ✔ Then the Front label is upright again ✔ And the block's front face is wider than it is tall again ✔ And the same part and model browser remain active

testcase.name: Scenario: Choose a corner from a face-on view: mnt/vininas-projects/MCAD-Scenarios/features/application/viewport-orientation/viewport-orientation.feature:63:3
testcase.system-out: Scenario: Choose a corner from a face-on view ✔ Given `fixtures/cad/docking-visible-solid-current.opd` is active with its rectangular block visible in the MCAD Software ✔ And the orientation control displays an upright Front view ✔ When the user selects the upper-right corner of the orientation control ✔ Then the block is displayed obliquely with its top, front and right faces visible ✔ And the orientation control shows the Top, Front and Right faces ✔ And the same part and model browser remain active

testcase.name: Scenario: Retain hybrid projection when selecting a named face: mnt/vininas-projects/MCAD-Scenarios/features/application/viewport-orientation/viewport-orientation.feature:138:3
testcase.system-out: Scenario: Retain hybrid projection when selecting a named face ✔ Given `fixtures/cad/docking-visible-solid-current.opd` is active with its rectangular block visible in the MCAD Software ✔ And it is displayed obliquely in Orthographic projection ✔ When the user chooses Perspective with Ortho Faces from the orientation control menu ✔ Then the block remains visible in an oblique view with a changed projection ✔ When the user selects Top on the orientation control ✔ Then the block is displayed face-on from the top ✔ And the orientation control displays Top ✔ When the user reopens the orientation control menu ✔ Then Perspective with Ortho Faces is marked as the current mode ✔ When the user chooses Orthographic ✔ Then the same part remains active in the top view

testcase.name: Scenario: Toggle orientation lock for a selected face: mnt/vininas-projects/MCAD-Scenarios/features/application/viewport-orientation/viewport-orientation.feature:246:3
testcase.system-out: Scenario: Toggle orientation lock for a selected face ✔ Given `fixtures/cad/docking-visible-solid-current.opd` is active with its rectangular block visible in the MCAD Software ✔ And no model geometry is selected ✔ When the user opens the orientation control context menu ✔ Then Lock to Current Selection is unavailable ✔ When the user closes the menu and selects a visible face of the block ✔ And the user opens the orientation control context menu ✔ Then Lock to Current Selection is available ✔ When the user chooses Lock to Current Selection ✔ Then a lock indicator appears beside the orientation control ✔ When the user reopens the orientation control context menu ✔ Then Lock to Current Selection is checked ✔ When the user chooses Lock to Current Selection again ✔ Then the lock indicator disappears ✔ When the user clears the face selection and reopens the orientation control context menu ✔ Then Lock to Current Selection is unavailable
